# What is actually in this BAI2 file?

> Free BAI2 file viewer and checker: turns a bank's BAI2 statement into accounts, balances and a transaction list you can download as CSV, and checks the 49, 98 and 99 control totals and record counts. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
